diagnosis.reasoning: Arrival rate actually fell 83% and prompt token rate is essentially flat, so this is not a capacity/workload increase. The prefix cache hit rate collapsed from 0.85 to 0.10 (cached token ratio likewise), which forces full prefill of ~3.5k-token prompts, inflating prefill_kv_computed and KV cache usage (0.09 -> 0.82), which in turn drives waiting requests, mild preemption, and the TTFT blowup. KV pressure, prefill cost, queueing and preemption are all downstream effects of the cache-reuse failure.
